title: Dynamo · Efficiency & SLA Patterns
description: Six selected-range average/p95 summaries and rolling trends, plus token-weighted vLLM prefix-cache reuse, for Dynamo deployments in daedalus-dynamo. Active-sample KV occupancy and output-token efficiency separate useful work from expected idle time; choose All observed time to include idle.

options.content:
**The cards summarize the entire selected time range, per deployment.** Start with **24 hours** or **7 days** for occasional household and agent traffic. Below, **Trend window** controls smoothing; solid lines show averages and dashed lines p95.

**KV Cache Occupancy** measures capacity in use. **Prefix Cache Reuse (vLLM)** below measures cached / queried prompt tokens; compare that ratio with benchmark reuse estimates. **Sample scope** applies only to occupancy and Tokens/Watt: active samples are output-producing one-minute windows; choose **All observed time** to include quiet periods. Latency and length always use actual observations. Gaps stay gaps; missing telemetry stays unavailable. Serving metrics are scoped to `daedalus-dynamo`, including requests from clients and agents in `daedalus`.
